title: Kickoff
description: Initialize the project from the template by interviewing the user. Run the `kickoff` skill.
acceptance_criteria: `AGENTS.md` is filled in (project, language, scope, stack, domain rules, quality gate, DoD additions) and the "template not initialized" notice is removed.

`docs/requirements/` contains goal, actors, in/out of scope and areas in `README.md`, the glossary, the release acceptance criteria of v0.1.0 in `acceptance.md`, and one file per first functional and non-functional requirement with a stable ID.
`docs/design/` contains the initial architectural decisions and the open decisions to be closed by backlog items in `README.md`, and one file per known design topic.
The backlog contains the goal of v0.1.0, its epics and its items with dependencies, requirements and acceptance criteria; ideas outside v0.1.0 are recorded as unassigned ideas.
`README.md` presents the project instead of the template; `CHANGELOG.md` and `.gitignore` are adapted to the project.
